# USR-005: Docker group has no extra members

- **Group:** Users and privilege
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Membership of the docker group is root on the host: a member can start a container that mounts / and changes anything. Every member is listed so the access is intentional.

## Verify by hand

```sh
getent group docker
```

## How to fix it

Remove users who do not need it: `gpasswd -d <user> docker`.

## What a fix can break

The removed user can no longer run docker without sudo.

Run `stackward explain USR-005` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
